name: series-drawer-picks-episode
description: The series button opens the episode drawer, and picking a row applies that episode through the host rather than silently reseating the same stream.

steps.note: Opens the drawer. Only visible because episodes seeded a playlist; a single-stream player keeps it hidden.

The first non-current row - index 0 is current, so playerSeriesItem is rows 1 and 2 and the click lands on episode 2. The rows carry the label as their accessible name, so this is the row a viewer reads as 'Episode 2'.
Bounded settle for the episode to apply; the assertions below carry the scenario.

assertions.note: Placeholder guard: picking an episode must not touch window mode. The real episode assertions follow once the time-pos contract is confirmed green.
